summary: Completed comprehensive testing of UniVicoustic 2D Product Configurator MVP. Backend API endpoints working perfectly with all 4 product types and proper mock data structure. Frontend UI functionality tested successfully including product type switching, dynamic configuration sections, canvas preview, localStorage favorites, and download functionality.

ui_bugs.issue: Emboss toggle testing limited due to category selection UI structure using custom components instead of standard select elements

passed_tests: Backend API /api/products returns all 4 product types correctly
Product type dropdown shows 'Coming Soon' for inactive products
VMD Panels shows Category, Size, Density, Designs sections
VicStrip Panels shows Pattern, Size, Thickness, Colors sections with 16 color swatches
Ombre Panels shows Category, Size, Designs sections (no colors/density)
Design thumbnails are clickable and update canvas preview
Color swatches change wall color for VicStrip panels
Save Design button saves to localStorage successfully
Favorites modal opens and shows saved designs
Delete favorite functionality works with localStorage persistence
Download button is clickable and functional
Reset button resets configuration with success message
Canvas preview renders textures correctly for all product types
Configuration summary displays current selection details
Product type switching works between all active products
Dynamic sections appear/hide based on product type selection
action_item_for_main_agent: Minor UI improvement: Consider adding more explicit data-testid attributes for category selection elements to improve automated testing coverage. The emboss toggle functionality exists in code but couldn't be fully tested due to custom UI component structure.
